groups.defect: The 10MB limit is hardcoded instead of read from the site setting. This happens in the client size check (utilities.js:182), in the 413 error message (utilities.js:246) and in the server download cap (uploads_controller.rb:55), so the limits no longer match what admins configure and the error message can show the wrong limit.
groups.rationale: Every member reports the same 10MB hardcode that replaced SiteSetting-driven limits. s_aaaa47e8 names both the client and server locations, which links the client-only and server-only reports.

groups.defect: OptimizedImage.downsize is defined twice. The later 3-arg dimensions version silently shadows the width/height version, which leaves dead code and breaks old-signature callers: the 5-arg call in resize_emoji.rb:14 raises ArgumentError, and 4-arg calls raise TypeError.
groups.rationale: All members report the same duplicate method definition and the broken calling contract that follows from it. Deleting one definition and updating the callers fixes all of them.

groups.defect: The 5-pass 80% downsize loop can't guarantee the image ends up under max_image_size_kb, contrary to what its comment says. It also ignores downsize failures, so an oversized or untouched file still reaches Upload.create_for.
groups.rationale: All three report that the bounded loop can exit with the file still over the limit. Two of them also mention that convert failures are ignored.
